mainEntity.name: When should I start coordinating cabinet installation during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to start coordinating cabinet installation early in your renovation planning, ideally when initial design decisions are being made. This allows for sufficient lead time for cabinet ordering, fabrication, and delivery, which can often take several weeks or even months for custom options. Early coordination with Frasheski Construction ensures that cabinet specifications are integrated with plumbing, electrical, and structural plans, preventing potential conflicts and helping maintain your project schedule. This preparation is crucial for a smooth overall construction process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin coordinating cabinet installation early in renovation planning to account for ordering and delivery lead times. This ensures cabinet specifications align with other trades, preventing project delays.
